newsitem.title: ANGOLA: RTZ Corp delegation on visit to Angola.
newsitem.headline: RTZ Corp delegation on visit to Angola.

text.p: A fact-finding delegation from British-based RTZ Corp Plc is visiting the Angolan capital Luanda for talks with the government on mining opportunities in the mineral and oil-rich country, Angola's news agency said on Thursday.
The delegation, headed by Neil McLaurin, Managing Director of RTZ's exploration, technology and information department earlier on Thursday met Angolan Prime Minister Franca Van Dunem.

McLaurin told the agency after the meeting that the visit follows earlier talks in London with senior officials from Angola's state diamond company Endiama and from the Ministry of Geology and Mining.
The report had no further details.
Angola holds vast mineral riches and is the world's sixth-biggest diamond producer.
Its economy is slowly emerging from the devastation caused by nearly two decades of civil war which ended in 1994 with the signing of a peace pact by the government and the opposition UNITA movement.
